task.description: Update CHANGELOG.md for ISS-0158; decide EXP-301/EXP-302 requirement status honestly; finalise ISS-0158 record; repair docs/issues/issue_index.json drift.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG entry records the four production fixes, the disproven premise, and the 3 forwarded blocks
Requirement status decision stated with reasoning

result.summary: CHANGELOG.md gains an ISS-0158 entry covering RC-1..RC-5 (emphasising RC-3, the missing NOT NULL events.sequence_number that prevented the async effects loop from ever closing in production), the retracted premise that transition() emits no effect_emitted for SERVICE_TASK, the 13->3 / 625-90-9 -> 634-88-2 measurements with zero regressions, the #515 dedupe, and the three forwarded blocks (#520/#521/#522). EXP-301 and EXP-302 deliberately left UNTRACKED: both are stage-null expansion-backlog entries never admitted to the tracked requirement set by WF-01, and EXP-301 additionally still has 3 of 12 blocks failing against its own retry/backoff and idempotent-dedup acceptance criteria. ISS-0158.json confirmed RESOLVED with resolution + prevention text and cross-referenced to ISS-0182/0186/0187/0188. Repaired issue_index.json drift: added 6 missing entries (ISS-0158, ISS-0180, ISS-0181, ISS-0186, ISS-0187, ISS-0188), corrected ISS-0182 to RESOLVED_DUPLICATE, and fixed next_issue_id from a stale 153 to 206 (highest real entry is ISS-0205).

issues.description: issue_index.json had drifted: 6 issue files were absent from the index and next_issue_id (153) was below the highest existing entry (ISS-0205), so the next allocated ID would have collided. Repaired here.
